'''Colonial Governor''' was the title given to the head of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Colonial Government]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Goroth Prime/Legends|Goroth Prime]]. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], [[Marsh Limoth]] held the post.
